title: What Is Avalanche? The Coin That Lets Anyone Launch a Blockchain (30 Seconds)
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Avalanche, launched in 2020 by Ava Labs, is a smart contract network where developers can launch their own custom chains, and its AVAX token pays fees and secures the network through staking (Galaxy Research, KuCoin Learn). scenes.head: WHAT IS AVALANCHE
scenes.hook: WHAT IF ANYONE COULD LAUNCH THEIR OWN BLOCKCHAIN?
scenes.narration: What if anyone could launch their own blockchain? That is the idea behind Avalanche.

scenes.head: THE IDEA
scenes.narration: Avalanche, launched in twenty twenty by Ava Labs, lets developers build custom chains with their own rules. Its main chain works with Ethereum apps.

scenes.head: THE TOKEN
scenes.hook: A V A X PAYS FEES AND SECURES THE NETWORK
scenes.narration: The A V A X token pays network fees. People can also stake it, which helps secure the network. Reports say transactions finalize in about two seconds.

scenes.head: THE LIMIT
scenes.hook: IT COMPETES WITH ETHEREUM'S OWN ADD-ONS
scenes.narration: The catch: Avalanche competes with Ethereum layer twos and other networks, so it has to keep winning developers.
